attributeDefinitions.name: clearance
attributeDefinitions.description: Hierarchical clearance. Platform creation order is highest to lowest privilege. Holding a level grants every lower level. Values on a TDF are https://attr.arkavo.com/attr/clearance/value/<level>.

attributeDefinitions.name: department
attributeDefinitions.description: Compartment orthogonal to clearance, populated per tenant. Conjunctive with clearance: a restricted clearance does not confer department access.

attributeDefinitions.name: project
attributeDefinitions.description: Second orthogonal compartment, populated per tenant. Kept separate from department so a project grant does not widen a department grant.

labels.label: public
labels.description: Content cleared for release. Wrapping is still available when a transport needs integrity, but is not required.

labels.label: internal
labels.description: Organization-internal content, including internal addresses and hostnames.

labels.label: pii
labels.description: Personal data. The floor matches DatumType::default_sensitivity so loading this map does not silently reclassify existing detections; a detector that reports a higher sensitivity for a specific datum, such as a national identity number at Restricted, wins by monotonic union. Release to an external destination requires explicit entitlement, per SEQ-003.

labels.label: financial
labels.description: Payment instruments and financial records. Conjunctive: clearance alone does not entitle.

labels.label: healthcare
labels.description: Health information. Held at restricted because re-identification survives most redaction.

labels.label: credentials
labels.description: API keys, passwords, tokens. Blocked unconditionally: a credential that reaches an egress path is already compromised, so entitlement and wrapping do not rescue it.

obligations.name: legal-hold
obligations.description: PDP-to-PEP directive: permit, provided the PEP enforces hold (no delete, redact, or expire). Not stamped on the TDF. The value FQN is https://attr.arkavo.com/obl/handling/value/legal-hold. A PEP that cannot enforce it must refuse.
